en.v: 2 rimmed baking sheets, cooling rack, 25 cm stainless-steel or non-stick skillet (you could also use a 25 cm stainless-steel-lined copper skillet)

sk.v: 2 plechy s okrajom, mriežka na chladenie, nerezová alebo nepriľnavá panvica 25 cm (môžeme použiť aj medenú panvicu 25 cm s nerezovou vrstvou)

en.v: The apples can be prepared and left to dry on the cooling rack for up to 3 hours. The tarte Tatin is best served the day it’s made; the longer it sits, the soggier the pastry will get.

sk.v: Jablká môžeme pripraviť a nechať osušiť na mriežke až 3 hodiny. Tarte Tatin je najlepší v deň prípravy; čím dlhšie stojí, tým viac cesto rozmokne.

c.t: Do not use cast iron, whose dark colour makes it hard to judge the caramel; with a nonstick skillet, use a silicone whisk.
Nepoužívajte liatinu, na tmavom povrchu sa zle posudzuje farba karamelu; pri nepriľnavej panvici použite silikónovú metličku.

en.t: One (397 g) package thawed puff pastry
2.8 liters boiling water
8 medium-large Pink Lady or Granny Smith apples (about 1300 g)
3 tsp (15 ml) apple cider vinegar, divided
200 g granulated sugar
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, cubed
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
Flaky sea salt, for garnish
Crème fraiche or whipped cream, for serving (optional)

1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and place a rimmed baking sheet on it (this is to catch any drips when the tarte Tatin bakes). Preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). On a well-floured work surface, roll 1 sheet of thawed puff pastry into a circle roughly 28 cm in diameter. Using a fork or a docking tool, prick the dough all over to dock, then place on a rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment, loosely cover with plastic, and refrigerate while you prepare the tarte Tatin filling.

2. Peel, core, and quarter the apples. Place in a large bowl and toss with 1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) apple cider vinegar, then pour boiling water over the prepared apples. Cover and set aside at room temperature for 10 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer apples to a rimmed baking sheet lined with a cooling rack and let stand until cool, about 10 minutes. Pat dry with paper towels if needed.

3. In a 25 cm stainless-steel or nonstick skillet set over medium heat, melt 120 ml granulated sugar until it begins to melt and caramelize. Add the remaining 120 ml granulated sugar and stir, using a clean, dry silicone spatula, until all the sugar dissolves and becomes an amber color, 3 to 5 minutes. Whisk in butter, 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract, and the remaining 1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) apple cider vinegar, and cook, whisking constantly, until the caramel bubbles, thickens slightly, and turns a butterscotch color, about 3 minutes. (The caramel will spit and look like it wants to seize, but keep going—the sugars will melt and loosen up as it continues to cook.)

4. Remove from heat and, using tongs and working one apple quarter at a time, add apple quarters, turning each piece to coat all over in the caramel and arranging them rounded side down to build a ring around the circumference of the skillet. Once the first ring is complete, repeat with additional apple quarters, dipping them into the caramel in the center and forming a second ring, also rounded side down, directly on top of the first, but positioned to fill the spaces between the apples in the first ring.

5. When the second ring is complete, dip remaining apple quarters into the caramel in the center, turning to coat, then fill in the center hole with 2 layers of apple quarters, all rounded side down (it is possible you will have a couple apple quarters left over that won't fit). Gently press down with a silicone spatula to ensure all the apples on the bottom layer come into contact with the caramel.

6. Return the pan to medium heat; bring caramel to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook until the caramel has darkened slightly and is bubbling around the edges and the apples on the bottom are just beginning to become tender but still retain their shape, about 5 minutes.

7. Top the apples with the prepared dough, tucking the edges down around the fruit. Gently press down on the pastry to flatten the apples underneath as much as possible. Transfer skillet to the oven and bake until the pastry is golden and the apples are bubbling around the sides, 20 to 25 minutes.

8. Remove from the oven and cool until pan is still slightly warm but cool enough to touch, 1 to 2 hours (don't let the pan fully cool, as that could cause the caramel to thicken such that the tarte Tatin won't release when flipped). Cover the pan with a large dinner plate or platter, then carefully and quickly flip. Remove the pan. Garnish with flaky salt. Serve with a dollop of crème fraiche or whipped cream, if desired.

1. Rošt nastavíme do spodnej tretiny rúry a položíme naň plech s okrajom (zachytí prípadné kvapky počas pečenia tarte Tatin). Rúru predhrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Na dobre pomúčenej pracovnej doske vyvaľkáme 1 plát rozmrazeného lístkového cesta na kruh s priemerom asi 28 cm. Cesto vidličkou alebo valčekom na prepichovanie po celej ploche popicháme, preložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierom na pečenie, voľne prikryjeme fóliou a dáme do chladničky, kým pripravíme plnku.

2. Jablká olúpeme, vykrojíme jadrovníky a rozštvrtíme. Dáme ich do veľkej misy, premiešame s 1 1/2 ČL (7,5 ml) jablčného octu a zalejeme vriacou vodou. Prikryjeme a necháme stáť pri izbovej teplote 10 minút. Cedidlovou naberačkou ich preložíme na plech s okrajom s mriežkou a necháme vychladnúť, asi 10 minút. Ak treba, osušíme ich papierovými utierkami.

3. V nerezovej alebo nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom 25 cm (pozri poznámku) na stredne silnom ohni roztopíme 90 ml kryštálového cukru, kým sa nezačne topiť a karamelizovať. Pridáme zvyšných 90 ml kryštálového cukru a miešame čistou suchou silikónovou stierkou, kým sa všetok cukor nerozpustí a nezíska jantárovú farbu, 3 až 5 minút. Zašľaháme maslo, 1 ČL (5 ml) vanilkového extraktu a zvyšných 1 1/2 ČL (7,5 ml) jablčného octu a za stáleho šľahania varíme, kým karamel nebublá, mierne nezhustne a nezíska farbu maslového karamelu, asi 3 minúty. (Karamel bude prskať a môže sa zdať, že stuhne, ale pokračujeme – cukry sa pri ďalšom varení roztopia a karamel povolí.)

4. Odstavíme z ohňa a pomocou klieští pridávame štvrtky jabĺk po jednej, každú obalíme v karamele zo všetkých strán a ukladáme ich zaoblenou stranou nadol do kruhu po obvode panvice. Keď je prvý kruh hotový, pokračujeme ďalšími štvrtkami: namáčame ich do karamelu v strede a ukladáme druhý kruh, tiež zaoblenou stranou nadol, priamo na prvý, ale tak, aby vypĺňal medzery medzi jablkami prvého kruhu.

5. Keď je hotový aj druhý kruh, zvyšné štvrtky namočíme do karamelu v strede, obalíme a vyplníme nimi stredový otvor v 2 vrstvách, všetky zaoblenou stranou nadol (môže sa stať, že zostane zopár štvrtiek, ktoré sa už nezmestia). Jemne pritlačíme silikónovou stierkou, aby sa všetky jablká v spodnej vrstve dotýkali karamelu.

6. Panvicu vrátime na stredne silný oheň, karamel privedieme k miernemu varu, potom stiahneme oheň na mierny a varíme, kým karamel mierne nestmavne, po okrajoch nebublá a jablká na dne nezačnú mäknúť, no stále držia tvar, asi 5 minút.

7. Jablká prikryjeme pripraveným cestom a okraje zastrčíme okolo ovocia. Cesto jemne pritlačíme, aby sa jablká pod ním čo najviac zarovnali. Panvicu vložíme do rúry a pečieme, kým cesto nie je zlatisté a jablká po okrajoch nebublú, 20 až 25 minút.

8. Vyberieme z rúry a necháme chladnúť, kým je panvica ešte mierne teplá, ale dá sa jej dotknúť, 1 až 2 hodiny (panvicu nenecháme úplne vychladnúť, karamel by zhustol tak, že by sa tarte Tatin po prevrátení neuvoľnil). Panvicu prikryjeme veľkým tanierom alebo podnosom a opatrne a rýchlo prevrátime. Panvicu odstránime. Posypeme vločkovou soľou. Podávame s lyžicou crème fraîche alebo šľahačky, ak chceme.

src: Serious Eats — Leah Colins — "Lemon Tart Recipe"

en.v: 23 cm tart pan with removable bottom, wire rack and rimmed baking sheet, medium saucepan

sk.v: Forma na tart 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom, mriežka a plech s okrajom, stredná rajnica

en.v: Crust can be made up to 24 hours in advance of filling. After baking, cool crust completely, then wrap loosely in plastic wrap and store at room temperature until ready to fill. Leftover tart can be covered with plastic wrap and stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

sk.v: Korpus môžeme pripraviť až 24 hodín pred plnením. Po upečení ho necháme úplne vychladnúť, voľne zabalíme do fólie a do plnenia uchovávame pri izbovej teplote. Zvyšný koláč môžeme prikryť fóliou a uchovávať v chladničke až 3 dni.

en.t: 190 g all-purpose flour
50 g granulated sugar
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume)
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly
2 tbsp (30 ml) water
3 large whole eggs plus 6 large egg yolks
120 ml honey
59 ml grated lemon zest plus 175 ml juice (4 lemons)
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume)
4 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm pieces
3 tbsp (44 ml) heavy cream

1. For the Crust: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, and salt together. Pour butter and water into the flour mixture and using a flexible spatula, stir until well combined and a uniform dough is formed.

2. Using your hands, pinch off and distribute three-quarters of the dough over the bottom of a 23 cm tart pan with a removable bottom. Using your hands and an off-set spatula or the bottom of a large measuring cup, press dough to an even thickness in the bottom of the pan. Pinch the remaining dough into smaller pieces and scatter evenly around the edge of the pan, then use your fingers to press dough into fluted sides of the pan. Press dough to even thickness until sides are completely covered.

3. Place the dough-lined pan on wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet and bake until crust is light golden brown and firm to touch, 25 to 35 minutes, rotating pan halfway through baking. Set aside until ready to fill. (Cooled crust can be wrapped loosely in plastic wrap and stored at room temperature for up to 24 hours.)

4. For the Lemon Filling: Whisk eggs and yolks, honey, lemon zest and juice, and salt together in a medium saucepan until smooth. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly with rubber spatula, until mixture thickens slightly and registers 75 °C, 5 to 7 minutes. Off heat, whisk in butter until melted. Strain lemon curd through fine-mesh strainer set over a bowl, then gently stir cream into the strained mixture with a rubber spatula.

5. Pour the warm lemon curd over the baked crust. Bake until the filling is shiny and opaque and center jiggles slightly when shaken, 10 to 12 minutes, rotating halfway through baking. Cool on a wire rack to room temperature, at least 1 hour.

1. Cesto: Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru zohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku, cukor a soľ. Maslo a vodu vlejeme do múčnej zmesi a pružnou stierkou miešame, kým sa dobre nespojí a nevznikne jednotné cesto.

2. Rukami odtrhávame tri štvrtiny cesta a rozdelíme ich po dne formy na tart s priemerom 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom. Rukami a lomenou stierkou alebo dnom veľkej odmerky cesto natlačíme na dne formy do rovnomernej hrúbky. Zvyšok cesta natrháme na menšie kúsky, rovnomerne ich rozložíme po okraji formy a prstami natlačíme do vrúbkovaných stien. Cesto tlačíme do rovnomernej hrúbky, kým nie sú steny celé pokryté.

3. Formu s cestom položíme na mriežku na plechu s okrajom a pečieme, kým korpus nie je svetlo zlatohnedý a pevný na dotyk, 25 až 35 minút; v polovici pečenia formu otočíme. Odložíme, kým ho nenaplníme. (Vychladnutý korpus môžeme voľne zabaliť do potravinovej fólie a skladovať pri izbovej teplote najviac 24 hodín.)

4. Citrónová plnka: V strednom hrnci vyšľaháme dohladka vajcia so žĺtkami, med, citrónovú kôru a šťavu a soľ. Varíme na stredne miernom ohni za stáleho miešania gumovou stierkou, kým zmes mierne nezhustne a teplomer neukáže 75 °C, 5 až 7 minút. Mimo ohňa zašľaháme maslo, kým sa neroztopí. Citrónový krém precedíme cez jemné sitko do misy, potom doň gumovou stierkou jemne vmiešame smotanu.

5. Teplý citrónový krém nalejeme na upečený korpus. Pečieme, kým plnka nie je lesklá a nepriehľadná a stred sa pri zatrasení len jemne chveje, 10 až 12 minút; v polovici pečenia formu otočíme. Necháme vychladnúť na mriežke na izbovú teplotu, aspoň 1 hodinu.

cat.en: Use plenty of fresh lemon juice and zest in the curd for the brightest, tangiest filling.
cat.sk: Do krému použite dosť čerstvej citrónovej šťavy a kôry, plnka bude čo najsviežejšia a najkyslejšia.

en.v: 23 cm tart pan with removable bottom, wire rack and rimmed baking sheet, pastry brush

sk.v: Forma na tart 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom, mriežka a plech s okrajom, cukrársky štetec

en.v: Pastry cream can be stored in an airtight container, with plastic wrap or buttered parchment paper placed directly on the surface, and refrigerated for up to 3 days before assembling the tart. Crust can be made up to 24 hours in advance of assembling the tart. After baking, cool crust completely, then wrap loosely in plastic wrap and store at room temperature until ready to fill. The assembled fruit tart can be refrigerated, uncovered, for up to 24 hours. If refrigerated for more than 1 hour, let it sit at room temperature for 1 hour before serving.

sk.v: Cukrársky krém môžeme uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe s fóliou alebo maslom potretým papierom na pečenie priamo na povrchu a v chladničke až 3 dni pred skladaním koláča. Korpus môžeme pripraviť až 24 hodín pred skladaním. Po upečení ho necháme úplne vychladnúť, voľne zabalíme do fólie a do plnenia uchovávame pri izbovej teplote. Poskladaný ovocný koláč môžeme uchovávať v chladničke nezakrytý až 24 hodín. Ak bol v chladničke dlhšie ako 1 hodina, necháme ho pred podávaním 1 hodina postáť pri izbovej teplote.

en.t: 190 g all-purpose flour
50 g granulated sugar
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume)
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly
2 tbsp (30 ml) water
1 recipe pastry cream (see crème pâtissière, chapter 30), prepared and refrigerated at least 2 hours and up to 3 days before assembly
455 g assorted berries such as raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, and/or strawberries
2 ripe peaches, nectarines, or plums halved, pitted, and cut into 0.5 cm wedges or 2 kiwis, peeled and sliced into 0.5 cm thick rounds
79 ml red currant or apple jelly
1 tsp (5 ml) water

1. For the crust: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, and salt together. Pour butter and water into the flour mixture and, using a flexible spatula, stir until well combined and a uniform dough is formed.

2. Using your hands, pinch off and distribute three-quarters of the dough over the bottom of a 23 cm tart pan with a removable bottom. Using your hands and an off-set spatula or the bottom of a large measuring cup, press dough to an even thickness in the bottom of the pan. Pinch the remaining dough into smaller pieces and scatter evenly around the edge of the pan, then use your fingers to press dough into fluted sides of the pan. Press dough to even thickness until sides are completely covered.

3. Place the dough-lined pan on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet and bake until the crust is golden brown and firm to touch, 30 to 35 minutes, rotating pan halfway through baking. Set aside until ready to fill. (Cooled crust can be wrapped loosely in plastic wrap and stored at room temperature for up to 24 hours.)

4. For the tart: Whisk the chilled filling until smooth, then transfer filling to the tart shell. Using an offset-spatula or back of a large spoon, spread it into an even smooth layer. Arrange fruit on top of pastry cream in your preferred design.

5. In a small bowl, microwave jelly and 1 tsp (5 ml) water until fluid, 20 to 30 seconds. Using a pastry brush, gently dab mixture over fruit, avoiding crust. Refrigerate the tart for at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours.
6. Remove the outer metal ring of the tart pan. Slide a thin metal spatula between the tart and the metal pan bottom to loosen the tart, then carefully slide the tart onto a serving platter.

1. Cesto: Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru zohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku, cukor a soľ. Maslo a vodu vlejeme do múčnej zmesi a pružnou stierkou miešame, kým sa dobre nespojí a nevznikne jednotné cesto.

2. Rukami odtrhávame tri štvrtiny cesta a rozdelíme ich po dne formy na tart s priemerom 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom. Rukami a lomenou stierkou alebo dnom veľkej odmerky cesto natlačíme na dne formy do rovnomernej hrúbky. Zvyšok cesta natrháme na menšie kúsky, rovnomerne ich rozložíme po okraji formy a prstami natlačíme do vrúbkovaných stien. Cesto tlačíme do rovnomernej hrúbky, kým nie sú steny celé pokryté.

3. Formu s cestom položíme na mriežku na plechu s okrajom a pečieme, kým korpus nie je zlatohnedý a pevný na dotyk, 30 až 35 minút; v polovici pečenia formu otočíme. Odložíme, kým ho nenaplníme. (Vychladnutý korpus môžeme voľne zabaliť do potravinovej fólie a skladovať pri izbovej teplote najviac 24 hodín.)

4. Tart: Vychladený krém vyšľaháme dohladka a preložíme do korpusu. Lomenou stierkou alebo chrbtom veľkej lyžice ho rozotrieme do rovnej hladkej vrstvy. Na krém poukladáme ovocie podľa vlastného vzoru.

5. V malej miske zohrejeme v mikrovlnnej rúre želé s 1 ČL (5 ml) vody, kým nie je tekuté, 20 až 30 sekúnd. Cukrárskym štetcom zmesou jemne potrieme ovocie, korpusu sa vyhneme. Tart dáme do chladničky aspoň na 30 minút alebo najviac na 24 hodín.
6. Odstránime vonkajší kovový kruh formy. Medzi tart a kovové dno formy zasunieme tenkú kovovú stierku, tart uvoľníme a opatrne ho presunieme na servírovací tanier.

en.v: The dough can be refrigerated for up to 3 days; before using, let it stand at room temperature until malleable but still cool.

sk.v: Cesto môžete uchovávať v chladničke až 3 dni; pred použitím ho nechajte pri izbovej teplote, kým nie je tvárne, ale stále chladné.

en.t: 1 large egg yolk (≈18 g)
2 tbsp (30 ml) heavy cream
71 g sliced almonds, toasted
50 g sugar
142 g all-purpose flour
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) salt
6 tbsp (85 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm pieces
295 ml heavy cream
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) instant espresso powder
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) salt
255 g bittersweet chocolate, chopped fine
4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter, cut into thin slices and softened
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell), lightly beaten, room temperature
3 tbsp (44 ml) heavy cream
1 tbsp (15 ml) light corn syrup
57 g bittersweet chocolate, chopped fine
1 tbsp (15 ml) hot water
1. **FOR THE CRUST:**

2. Beat egg yolk and cream together in small bowl. Process almonds and sugar in food processor until nuts are finely ground, 15 to 20 seconds. Add flour and salt; pulse to combine, about 10 pulses. Scatter butter over flour mixture; pulse to cut butter into flour until mixture resembles coarse meal, about 15 pulses. With processor running, add egg yolk mixture and process until dough forms ball, about 10 seconds. Transfer dough to large sheet of plastic wrap and press into 15 cm disk; wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate until firm but malleable, about 30 minutes. (Dough can be refrigerated for up to 3 days; before using, let stand at room temperature until malleable but still cool.)

3. Roll out dough between 2 large sheets of plastic into 28 cm round about 1 cm thick. (If dough becomes too soft and sticky to work with, slip it onto baking sheet and refrigerate until workable.) Place dough round (still in plastic) on baking sheet and refrigerate until firm but pliable, about 15 minutes.

4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Spray 23 cm tart pan with removable bottom with vegetable oil spray. Keeping dough on sheet, remove top layer of plastic. Invert tart pan (with bottom) on top of dough round. Press on tart pan to cut dough. Using 2 hands, pick up sheet and tart pan and carefully invert both, setting tart pan right side up. Remove sheet and peel off plastic; reserve plastic. Roll over edges of tart pan with rolling pin to cut dough. Gently ease and press dough into bottom of pan, reserving scraps. Roll dough scraps into 2 cm-diameter rope (various lengths are OK). Line edge of tart pan with rope(s) and gently press into fluted sides. Line tart pan with reserved plastic and, using measuring cup, gently press and smooth dough to even thickness (sides should be about 0.5 cm thick). Using paring knife, trim any excess dough above rim of tart; discard scraps. Freeze dough-lined pan until firm, 20 to 30 minutes.

5. Set dough-lined pan on baking sheet. Spray 30 cm square of aluminum foil with oil spray and press foil, sprayed side down, into pan; fill with 475 ml pie weights. Bake until dough is dry and light golden brown, about 25 minutes, rotating pan halfway through baking. Carefully remove foil and weights and continue to bake until pastry is rich golden brown and fragrant, 8 to 10 minutes longer. Let cool completely on sheet on wire rack.
6. **FOR THE FILLING:**

7. Heat oven to 120 °C (fan 100 °C). Bring cream, espresso powder, and salt to simmer in small saucepan over medium heat, stirring once or twice to dissolve espresso powder and salt. Meanwhile, place chocolate in large heatproof bowl. Pour simmering cream mixture over chocolate, cover, and let stand for 5 minutes to allow chocolate to soften. Using whisk, stir mixture slowly and gently (so as not to incorporate air) until homogeneous. Add butter and continue to whisk gently until fully incorporated. Pour eggs through fine-mesh strainer into chocolate mixture; whisk slowly until mixture is homogeneous and glossy. Pour filling into tart crust and shake gently from side to side to distribute and smooth surface; pop any large bubbles with toothpick or skewer. Bake tart, on baking sheet, until outer edge of filling is just set and very faint cracks appear on surface, 30 to 35 minutes; filling will still be very wobbly. Let cool completely on sheet on wire rack. Refrigerate, uncovered, until filling is chilled and set, at least 3 hours or up to 18 hours.
8. **FOR THE GLAZE:**

9. Thirty minutes before glazing, remove tart from refrigerator. Bring cream and corn syrup to simmer in small saucepan over medium heat; stir once or twice to combine. Remove pan from heat, add chocolate, and cover. Let stand for 5 minutes to allow chocolate to soften. Whisk gently (so as not to incorporate air) until mixture is smooth, then whisk in hot water until glaze is homogeneous, shiny, and pourable. Working quickly, pour glaze onto center of tart. To distribute glaze, tilt tart and allow glaze to run to edge. (Spreading glaze with spatula will leave marks on surface.) Pop any large bubbles with toothpick or skewer. Let stand for at least 1 hour or up to 3 hours.
10. Remove outer ring from tart pan. Insert thin bladed metal spatula between crust and pan bottom to loosen tart; slide tart onto serving platter. Cut into wedges and serve.

1. **NA CESTO:**

2. V malej miske vyšľaháme žĺtok so smotanou. Mandle s cukrom rozmixujeme v mixéri nadrobno, 15 až 20 sekúnd. Pridáme múku a soľ a premiešame pulzným mixovaním, asi 10 pulzov. Maslo rozložíme na múčnu zmes a pulzným mixovaním ho zapracujeme, kým zmes nepripomína hrubú krupicu, asi 15 pulzov. Za chodu mixéra prilejeme žĺtkovú zmes a mixujeme, kým cesto nevytvorí guľu, asi 10 sekúnd. Cesto preložíme na veľký kus potravinovej fólie a vytlačíme z neho disk s priemerom 15 cm; zabalíme ho do fólie a necháme v chladničke, kým nie je pevné, ale tvárne, asi 30 minút. (Cesto vydrží v chladničke najviac 3 dni; pred použitím ho necháme postáť pri izbovej teplote, kým nie je tvárne, ale stále chladné.)

3. Cesto vyvaľkáme medzi 2 veľkými kusmi fólie na kruh s priemerom 28 cm a hrúbkou asi 1 cm. (Ak cesto zmäkne a lepí sa, presunieme ho na plech a necháme v chladničke, kým sa s ním nedá pracovať.) Kruh cesta (stále vo fólii) položíme na plech a necháme v chladničke, kým nie je pevný, ale ohybný, asi 15 minút.

4. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru zohrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Formu na tart s priemerom 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom vystriekame olejovým sprejom. Cesto necháme na plechu a odstránime vrchnú fóliu. Formu (s dnom) obrátenú hore dnom položíme na cesto. Pritlačením formy cesto vykrojíme. Oboma rukami zdvihneme plech aj s formou a opatrne ich spolu prevrátime, aby forma stála správne. Plech odstránime a stiahneme fóliu; fóliu si odložíme. Cez okraje formy prejdeme valčekom, aby sme cesto orezali. Cesto jemne vtlačíme do dna formy, odrezky si odložíme. Z odrezkov vyvaľkáme šnúrky s priemerom 2 cm (rôzne dĺžky nevadia). Šnúrkami obložíme okraj formy a jemne ich vtlačíme do vrúbkovaných stien. Formu vystelieme odloženou fóliou a odmerkou cesto jemne pritlačíme a zarovnáme do rovnomernej hrúbky (steny by mali byť hrubé asi 0,5 cm). Nožíkom odrežeme prebytočné cesto nad okrajom formy; odrezky vyhodíme. Formu s cestom zamrazíme, kým nie je pevná, 20 až 30 minút.

5. Formu s cestom položíme na plech. Štvorec alobalu 30 cm vystriekame olejovým sprejom a vtlačíme ho postriekanou stranou nadol do formy; naplníme 475 ml závaží na pečenie. Pečieme, kým cesto nie je suché a svetlo zlatohnedé, asi 25 minút; v polovici pečenia formu otočíme. Opatrne odstránime alobal so závažiami a pečieme ďalej, kým cesto nie je sýto zlatohnedé a voňavé, ešte 8 až 10 minút. Necháme úplne vychladnúť na plechu na mriežke.
6. **NA PLNKU:**

7. Rúru zohrejeme na 120 °C (teplovzdušnú na 100 °C). V malom hrnci na stredne silnom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu smotanu, espresso prášok a soľ, raz-dva zamiešame, aby sa espresso prášok a soľ rozpustili. Medzitým dáme čokoládu do veľkej žiaruvzdornej misy. Horúcu smotanovú zmes nalejeme na čokoládu, prikryjeme a necháme stáť 5 minút, aby čokoláda zmäkla. Metličkou pomaly a jemne miešame (aby sa nezapracoval vzduch), kým nie je zmes jednotná. Pridáme maslo a ďalej jemne miešame, kým sa úplne nespojí. Vajcia precedíme cez jemné sitko do čokoládovej zmesi; pomaly miešame, kým nie je zmes jednotná a lesklá. Plnku nalejeme do korpusu a jemne zatrasieme zo strany na stranu, aby sa rozliala a povrch sa zarovnal; väčšie bublinky prepichneme špáradlom alebo špajdľou. Tart pečieme na plechu, kým vonkajší okraj plnky práve nestuhne a na povrchu sa neobjavia veľmi jemné prasklinky, 30 až 35 minút; plnka bude stále veľmi trasľavá. Necháme úplne vychladnúť na plechu na mriežke. Nezakrytý dáme do chladničky, kým plnka nevychladne a nestuhne, aspoň na 3 hodiny alebo najviac na 18 hodín.
8. **NA POLEVU:**

9. 30 minút pred polievaním vyberieme tart z chladničky. V malom hrnci na stredne silnom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu smotanu a kukuričný sirup; raz-dva zamiešame. Hrniec odstavíme, pridáme čokoládu a prikryjeme. Necháme stáť 5 minút, aby čokoláda zmäkla. Jemne miešame metličkou (aby sa nezapracoval vzduch), kým nie je zmes hladká, potom vmiešame horúcu vodu, kým nie je poleva jednotná, lesklá a dá sa liať. Rýchlo nalejeme polevu do stredu tartu. Tart nakláňame, aby poleva stiekla až k okraju. (Rozotieranie polevy stierkou by na povrchu zanechalo stopy.) Väčšie bublinky prepichneme špáradlom alebo špajdľou. Necháme stáť aspoň 1 hodinu alebo najviac 3 hodiny.
10. Odstránime vonkajší kruh formy. Medzi korpus a dno formy zasunieme tenkú kovovú stierku, tart uvoľníme a presunieme na servírovací tanier. Nakrájame na kúsky a podávame.

en.t: 142 g unblanched hazelnuts, toasted and skinned
57 g blanched almonds
125 g granulated sugar
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
1 tsp (5 ml) grated lemon zest (from 1 lemon)
213 g unbleached all-purpose flour
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) ground cinnamon
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) ground allspice
12 tbsp (170 g) unsalted butter (170 g), cut into 1.5 cm cubes and chilled
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
383 g raspberry preserves
1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice (from 1 lemon)
1 tbsp (15 ml) heavy cream
1 1/2 tsp (6 g) turbinado sugar, or demerara (optional)
1. **FOR THE TART DOUGH:**

2. Whisk egg and vanilla together in bowl. Process hazelnuts, sugar, almonds, and salt in food processor until very finely ground, 45 to 60 seconds. Add lemon zest and pulse to combine, about 5 pulses. Add flour, cinnamon, and allspice and pulse to combine, about 5 pulses. Scatter butter over top and pulse until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal, about 15 pulses. With processor running, add egg mixture and continue to process until dough just comes together, about 12 seconds longer.

3. Transfer dough to counter and form into cohesive mound. Divide dough in half and form each half into 13 cm disk. (If not using immediately, wrap disks tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Let chilled dough sit at room temperature until soft and malleable, about 1 hour, before using.)

4. Tear 1 disk into walnut-size pieces, then pat pieces into 28 cm tart pan with removable bottom, pressing dough into corners and 2 cm up sides of pan. Cover dough with plastic and smooth out any bumps using bottom of measuring cup. Set pan on large plate and freeze until firm, about 30 minutes.

5. Roll second disk into 30 cm square between 2 large sheets of floured parchment paper. (If dough sticks to parchment, gently loosen and lift sticky area with bench scraper and dust parchment with additional flour.) Slide dough, still between parchment, onto rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate until firm, about 15 minutes. Remove top layer of parchment and trim edges of dough to form perfect square, then cut into 2 cm-wide strips, cutting through underlying parchment. Cover with parchment and freeze until dough is fully chilled and firm, about 20 minutes.

6. Meanwhile, adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Set dough-lined tart pan on rimmed baking sheet. Spray 1 side of double layer of aluminum foil with vegetable oil spray. Press foil, greased side down, into frozen tart shell, covering edges to prevent burning, and fill with pie weights. Bake until tart shell is golden brown and set, about 30 minutes, rotating sheet halfway through baking. Remove foil and weights, transfer sheet to wire rack, and let cool completely, about 1 hour.
7. **FOR THE FILLING:**

8. Stir raspberry preserves and lemon juice together in bowl. Spread filling evenly over bottom of tart shell. Pick up 1 strip of dough by parchment ends, then flip it over onto tart, positioning it near edge of pan. Remove parchment strip and trim ends of dough strip by pressing down on top edge of pan; reserve all dough scraps. Place 2 more strips parallel to first, spacing them evenly so that one is across center and other is near opposite edge of pan. Rotate pan 90°, then place 3 more strips spacing as with first three. Rotate pan 90° again, then place 2 strips across pan, spaced evenly between first three. Rotate pan again and complete lattice by placing last 2 strips between second set of three. Use small scraps of dough to fill in crust around edges between lattice strips. Top of crust should be just below top of pan.

9. Gently brush lattice strips with cream and sprinkle with sugar, if using. Bake on sheet until crust is deep golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes. Let tart cool completely on sheet on wire rack, about 2 hours. Remove outer ring of tart pan, slide thin metal spatula between tart and tart pan bottom, and carefully slide tart onto serving platter or cutting board. Serve or refrigerate overnight.

1. **NA CESTO:**

2. V miske vyšľaháme vajce s vanilkou. Lieskové orechy, cukor, mandle a soľ rozmixujeme v mixéri veľmi nadrobno, 45 až 60 sekúnd. Pridáme citrónovú kôru a premiešame pulzným mixovaním, asi 5 pulzov. Pridáme múku, škoricu a nové korenie a premiešame pulzným mixovaním, asi 5 pulzov. Navrch rozložíme maslo a pulzne mixujeme, kým zmes nepripomína hrubú kukuričnú krupicu, asi 15 pulzov. Za chodu mixéra pridáme vaječnú zmes a mixujeme, kým sa cesto práve nespojí, ešte asi 12 sekúnd.

3. Cesto preložíme na pracovnú dosku a spojíme do súdržnej kôpky. Rozdelíme ho na polovicu a z každej polovice vytvarujeme disk s priemerom 13 cm. (Ak ho hneď nepoužijeme, disky pevne zabalíme do potravinovej fólie a uložíme do chladničky najviac na 2 dni. Pred použitím necháme vychladené cesto postáť pri izbovej teplote, kým nie je mäkké a tvárne, asi 1 hodinu.)

4. 1 disk natrháme na kúsky veľkosti vlašského orecha a natlačíme ich do formy na tart s priemerom 28 cm s vyberateľným dnom, aj do rohov a 2 cm hore po stenách formy. Cesto prikryjeme fóliou a dnom odmerky zarovnáme hrbolčeky. Formu položíme na veľký tanier a zamrazíme, kým nie je pevná, asi 30 minút.

5. Druhý disk vyvaľkáme medzi 2 veľkými pomúčenými papiermi na pečenie na štvorec 30 cm. (Ak sa cesto lepí na papier, lepiace miesto jemne uvoľníme a nadvihneme škrabkou na cesto a papier poprášime ďalšou múkou.) Cesto, stále medzi papiermi, presunieme na plech s okrajom a necháme v chladničke, kým nie je pevné, asi 15 minút. Odstránime vrchný papier, okraje cesta orežeme na dokonalý štvorec a potom ho nakrájame na pásiky široké 2 cm, aj so spodným papierom. Prikryjeme papierom na pečenie a zamrazíme, kým cesto nie je úplne vychladené a pevné, asi 20 minút.

6. Medzitým nastavíme rošt do stredu rúry a rúru zohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Formu s cestom položíme na plech s okrajom. Dvojitú vrstvu alobalu z 1 strany vystriekame olejovým sprejom. Alobal vymastenou stranou nadol vtlačíme do zamrazeného korpusu, prekryjeme ním aj okraje, aby sa nepripálili, a naplníme závažiami na pečenie. Pečieme, kým korpus nie je zlatohnedý a pevný, asi 30 minút; v polovici pečenia plech otočíme. Odstránime alobal so závažiami, plech preložíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 1 hodinu.
7. **NA PLNKU:**

8. V miske zmiešame malinový džem s citrónovou šťavou. Plnku rovnomerne rozotrieme po dne korpusu. 1 pásik cesta zdvihneme za konce papiera, prevrátime ho na tart a umiestnime ho blízko okraja formy. Papierový pásik odstránime a konce pásika cesta orežeme pritlačením na horný okraj formy; všetky odrezky si odložíme. Ďalšie 2 pásiky položíme rovnobežne s prvým, rovnomerne rozmiestnené tak, aby jeden išiel stredom a druhý blízko protiľahlého okraja formy. Formu otočíme o 90° a položíme ďalšie 3 pásiky s rovnakými rozostupmi ako prvé tri. Formu znova otočíme o 90° a položíme 2 pásiky cez formu, rovnomerne medzi prvé tri. Formu znova otočíme a mriežku dokončíme položením posledných 2 pásikov medzi druhú trojicu. Malými odrezkami cesta vyplníme okraj medzi pásikmi mriežky. Vrch korpusu by mal byť tesne pod okrajom formy.

9. Pásiky mriežky jemne potrieme smotanou a ak chceme, posypeme cukrom. Pečieme na plechu, kým korpus nie je sýto zlatohnedý, 40 až 45 minút. Tart necháme úplne vychladnúť na plechu na mriežke, asi 2 hodiny. Odstránime vonkajší kruh formy, medzi tart a dno formy zasunieme tenkú kovovú stierku a tart opatrne presunieme na servírovací tanier alebo dosku. Podávame hneď alebo necháme cez noc v chladničke.

en.t: 6 tbsp (85 g) unsalted butter, at room temperature
99 g granulated sugar
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) table salt
96 g King Arthur Almond Flour
3 tbsp (23 g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour or King Arthur Gluten-Free Measure for Measure Flour
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell), at room temperature
2 tsp (10 ml) almond emulsion or almond extract
1. In a medium bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, beat together the butter, sugar, and salt until pale and fluffy, about 1 minute on medium speed.
2. Stir in the flours, egg, and almond flavoring. Mix until just combined.

3. Use the frangipane as desired: fill tart shells, pipe into croissant dough, top slices of Bostock, or come up with your own way to use this flavorful, nutty filling. Bake the frangipane as directed in your recipe or until it’s golden brown and smells nutty.
4. Store leftover unbaked frangipane in the refrigerator, covered, for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 2 months.

en.v: Rolling pin, Instant-read thermometer, 7cm-wide pasteis de nata tins about 1 1/2cm deep

sk.v: Valček na cesto, vpichový teplomer, formičky na pasteis de nata široké 7 cm a hlboké asi 1 1/2 cm

en.v: The dough can be made ahead of time and kept in the fridge but it will oxidise. It can be frozen for 30 days and defrosted. The syrup can be made ahead of time, but may crystallize. To dissolve sugar crystals, reheat syrup on the stove until syrup registers 105 °C on an instant-read thermometer The custard can be made 3 days in advance. Tarts are best the day they are baked, especially warm.

sk.v: Cesto môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke, ale oxiduje. Môžeme ho zmraziť na 30 dní a rozmraziť. Sirup môžeme pripraviť vopred, môže však skryštalizovať. Kryštáliky cukru rozpustíme tak, že sirup ohrejeme na sporáku, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 105 °C. Krém môžeme pripraviť 3 dni vopred. Košíčky sú najlepšie v deň upečenia, najmä teplé.

c.t: The syrup can be made ahead. For a more pronounced flavour, bring the milk to a boil with extra cinnamon sticks and lemon peel, then cover and infuse for at least 1 hour before continuing.
Sirup môžete pripraviť vopred. Pre výraznejšiu chuť priveďte mlieko do varu s ďalšími škoricovými tyčinkami a citrónovou kôrou, prikryte a nechajte lúhovať aspoň 1 hodinu, potom pokračujte.

en.t: 230 g all-purpose flour
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
120 g room temperature water
125 g cold unsalted butter (about 9 tbsp), cut into 1.5 cm-thick pieces plus
20 g room-temperature unsalted butter (about 1 1/2 tbsp), divided
226 g granulated sugar
One 5 cm strip lemon zest (optional)
Two 5 cm strips orange zest (optional)
Two 5 cm cinnamon sticks (about 10 g)
1 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped (optional)
110 g water
30 g cornstarch (3 tbsp)
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
165 g heavy cream
400 g whole milk
100 g egg yolks from about 6 large eggs
290 g syrup, see above
Confectioners' sugar
Ground cinnamon

1. For the Dough: In a medium bowl, whisk flour and salt to combine. Add water, stir to incorporate, and gently knead to form a rough dough. Transfer to a clean, lightly floured work surface and knead until a smooth dough forms, 7 to 10 minutes. (Alternatively, the dough can be prepared using a stand mixer: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, mix flour and salt to combine. Add water and mix on low speed until dough comes together, 1 to 2 minutes. Switch to the dough hook and mix on medium speed until a smooth dough forms, scraping down the sides if necessary, 3 to 4 minutes.) Wrap dough tightly with plastic and rest in refrigerator until slightly chilled, 30 minutes.

2. On a 23 × 33 cm sheet of parchment, arrange cut slices of the cold butter into a 15 × 7.5 cm rectangle. Top butter with another piece of parchment and, using a rolling pin, bash the butter until pliable. Roll the butter between the parchment until it is a 15 × 20 cm rectangle. Remove dough from fridge and press it into a 15 × 20 cm rectangle; position the dough on a lightly floured work surface so that the shorter edge is parallel to the counter edge.

3. Roll the dough lengthwise until it measures 41 cm long, or twice the length of your butter block. Unwrap the butter block and place it on the dough with its 15 cm sides parallel to the 15 cm sides of the dough; center the butter block along the 41 cm length, leaving 10 cm of dough exposed on either end. Fold bottom and top flaps of dough over butter so they meet in the center, pressing seam together with fingertips to seal.

4. Roll the dough lengthwise so it is approximately a 15 × 38 cm rectangle. Fold the dough into thirds like a business letter by bringing the top and bottom of the dough over the center. Turn the dough 90° and roll the dough away and towards yourself until it is about 38 cm long. Fold the dough into thirds once again. Wrap dough tightly in plastic, refrigerate, and let rest for 20 minutes.

5. Unwrap dough, return to a lightly floured work surface and roll the dough to an approximately 41 × 20 cm rectangle about 0.5 cm thick. Using an offset spatula, spread softened butter into a thin, even layer across the dough. Working from the long side of the dough, roll dough up tightly, pressing the last 2.5 cm of dough firmly onto the log of the pastry to seal. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours. (Dough will oxidize slightly after 24 hours; this won’t affect its flavor, but your dough will have a greyish hue.)

6. For the Syrup: In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, lemon zest, orange zest, cinnamon sticks, vanilla bean and scraped seeds, if using, and water. Bring syrup to a boil over high heat and cook, not stirring, until mixture registers 107 °C on an instant-read thermometer, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit until slightly cool, about 30 minutes.

7. For the Custard: In a small saucepan, whisk together the cornstarch, salt, heavy cream, and milk until well combined and smooth. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thickened and smooth like pudding, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly, about 10 minutes, before whisking in egg yolks, followed by the syrup, taking care to not incorporate too much air. Using a fine mesh sieve, strain mixture into a medium bowl, and let cool completely, about 30 minutes. Adjust oven rack to middle position, set pizza stone on rack, and preheat oven to 260 °C (fan 240 °C).

8. Remove the dough from the fridge and slice into 22 (1.5 cm-thick) pieces, each 15 to 20 g. Place the portioned dough into your tins and allow to warm to room temperature for 15 minutes. (The best way to ensure a flaky edge and neat finish is to line the tins while pastry is at the correct temperature. You want the dough to be soft, squidgy, and moveable.)

9. Wet your fingers with water and, using your thumbs, press center of dough and move it towards and up the edges of a 7 cm-wide pastéis de nata tin about 1.5 cm deep; the dough on the sides should be slightly thinner than the base. (Avoid touching the outside edges of the dough, as you may crush the delicate layers of dough and make it difficult for the pastry to puff and rise as it bakes.) Repeat with remaining tins, setting each on a 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking sheet, spacing each about 2.5 cm apart.
10. Refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes or up to 12 hours.
11. When you are ready to bake, carefully pour custard into tarts, stopping 0.5 cm from the rim of the pastry, about 2 tbsp (30 to 35 g) per tart.

12. Bake until the filling is puffed and pastry is crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Heat broiler to high and broil until custard is dark in spots, about 3 minutes. Depending on your oven, you may need to bake for longer or rotate halfway to ensure even baking. Let cool slightly before eating; dust tarts with confectioners’ sugar and/or cinnamon on top, if desired.
lactose-free butter or ghee — amount not reduced (structural: pastry/lamination/cream) — own adjustment
sugar/sweetener reduced to 75% ("226 g granulated sugar") — own adjustment
lactose-free whipping cream (30–33%) instead of cream — own adjustment
lactose-free milk 1.5% instead of milk (whole 3.5% lactose-free where richness is essential) — own adjustment
use about 75% of "Confectioners' sugar" — own adjustment

1. Cesto: V strednej mise metličkou premiešame múku so soľou. Pridáme vodu, zamiešame a jemne vymiesime hrubé cesto. Preložíme na čistú, zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú dosku a miesime, kým nevznikne hladké cesto, 7 až 10 minút. (Cesto môžeme pripraviť aj v kuchynskom robote: v mise robota s plochým miešadlom premiešame múku so soľou. Pridáme vodu a miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa cesto nespojí, 1 až 2 minúty. Vymeníme miešadlo za hák na cesto a miesime na strednej rýchlosti, kým nevznikne hladké cesto, podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny, 3 až 4 minúty.) Cesto pevne zabalíme do fólie a necháme odpočívať v chladničke, kým mierne nevychladne, 30 minút.

2. Na kus papiera na pečenie 23 × 33 cm poukladáme nakrájané plátky studeného masla do obdĺžnika 15 × 7,5 cm. Maslo prikryjeme ďalším papierom a valčekom ho búchame, kým nie je tvárne. Maslo medzi papiermi vyvaľkáme na obdĺžnik 15 × 20 cm. Cesto vyberieme z chladničky a vytlačíme ho na obdĺžnik 15 × 20 cm; položíme ho na zľahka pomúčenú dosku kratšou stranou rovnobežne s okrajom linky.

3. Cesto vyvaľkáme pozdĺžne na dĺžku 41 cm, teda na dvojnásobok dĺžky maslového bloku. Maslový blok rozbalíme a položíme ho na cesto tak, aby jeho 15 cm strany boli rovnobežné s 15 cm stranami cesta; blok umiestnime do stredu 41 cm dĺžky, takže na oboch koncoch zostane voľných 10 cm cesta. Spodný a vrchný okraj cesta preložíme cez maslo, aby sa stretli v strede, a spoj pritlačíme končekmi prstov.

4. Cesto vyvaľkáme pozdĺžne na obdĺžnik približne 15 × 38 cm. Cesto preložíme na tretiny ako list: vrchnú a spodnú časť preložíme cez stred. Cesto otočíme o 90° a valčekom ho vaľkáme od seba a k sebe, kým nie je dlhé asi 38 cm. Znova ho preložíme na tretiny. Cesto pevne zabalíme do fólie, dáme do chladničky a necháme odpočívať 20 minút.

5. Cesto rozbalíme, vrátime na zľahka pomúčenú dosku a vyvaľkáme na obdĺžnik približne 41 × 20 cm s hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm. Lomenou stierkou naň rozotrieme zmäknuté maslo v tenkej rovnomernej vrstve. Cesto od dlhšej strany pevne zrolujeme a posledných 2,5 cm pevne pritlačíme k rolke, aby sa spoj uzavrel. Necháme v chladničke aspoň 1 hodinu alebo najviac 24 hodín. (Po 24 hodinách cesto mierne oxiduje; chuť to neovplyvní, ale cesto bude mať sivastý odtieň.)

6. Sirup: V strednom hrnci zmiešame cukor, citrónovú kôru, pomarančovú kôru, škoricové tyčinky, vanilkový struk s vyškrabanými semienkami (ak ho používame) a vodu. Sirup privedieme na silnom ohni do varu a bez miešania varíme, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 107 °C, asi 5 minút. Odstavíme a necháme mierne vychladnúť, asi 30 minút.

7. Krém: V malom hrnci vyšľaháme kukuričný škrob, soľ, smotanu na šľahanie a mlieko, kým nie je zmes dobre spojená a hladká. Varíme na stredne silnom ohni za stáleho šľahania, kým nezhustne a nie je hladká ako puding, asi 6 minút. Odstavíme a necháme mierne vychladnúť, asi 10 minút, potom zašľaháme žĺtky a po nich sirup, pričom dbáme, aby sme nezapracovali príliš veľa vzduchu. Zmes precedíme cez jemné sitko do strednej misy a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 30 minút. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry, položíme naň kameň na pizzu a rúru predhrejeme na 260 °C (teplovzdušnú na 240 °C).

8. Cesto vyberieme z chladničky a nakrájame na 22 kúskov hrubých 1,5 cm, každý 15 až 20 g. Kúsky cesta vložíme do formičiek a necháme ich zohriať na izbovú teplotu 15 minút. (Najlepší spôsob, ako dosiahnuť lístkový okraj a pekný vzhľad, je vystlať formičky, keď má cesto správnu teplotu. Cesto má byť mäkké, poddajné a pohyblivé.)

9. Prsty navlhčíme vodou a palcami pritlačíme stred cesta a posúvame ho k okrajom a hore po stenách formičky na pastéis de nata so šírkou 7 cm a hĺbkou asi 1,5 cm; cesto na stenách má byť o niečo tenšie ako na dne. (Nedotýkame sa vonkajších okrajov cesta, mohli by sme pomliaždiť jemné vrstvy a cesto by sa pri pečení ťažko nafukovalo a dvíhalo.) Rovnako vystelieme ostatné formičky a každú položíme na plech s okrajom 33 × 46 cm s rozostupmi asi 2,5 cm.
10. Necháme v chladničke vychladiť aspoň 30 minút alebo najviac 12 hodín.
11. Keď sme pripravení piecť, opatrne nalejeme krém do košíčkov, 0,5 cm pod okraj cesta, asi 2 PL (30 až 35 g) na košíček.

12. Pečieme, kým sa plnka nenafúkne a cesto nie je chrumkavé, 8 až 10 minút. Gril zapneme na najvyšší stupeň a grilujeme, kým krém miestami nestmavne, asi 3 minúty. Podľa rúry možno budeme musieť piecť dlhšie alebo v polovici plech otočiť, aby sa piekli rovnomerne. Pred jedlom necháme mierne vychladnúť; ak chceme, košíčky posypeme práškovým cukrom a/alebo škoricou.

sugar.en: Total sugars (includes natural sugars; WHO limit is for free sugars) per serving: 9.0 g = 18 % of the WHO daily guide of 50 g (36 % of the ideal 25 g). Free sugars could not be worked out reliably: syrup, powdered sugar (with no amount / not counted). The total may be higher than shown: some sweet ingredients have no amount or no fitting database value.
sugar.sk: Celkové cukry (vrátane prirodzených cukrov; limit WHO platí pre voľné cukry) na porciu: 9,0 g = 18 % z denného odporúčania WHO 50 g (36 % z ideálnych 25 g). Voľné cukry sa nedali spoľahlivo vypočítať: sirup, práškový cukor (bez množstva / nezarátané). Celkové cukry môžu byť vyššie, než sa uvádza: niektoré sladké suroviny nemajú množstvo alebo vhodnú databázovú hodnotu.

en.v: Whisk, dough scraper; rolling pin; 23 cm fluted tart pan with removable bottom; dried beans, raw rice, or baking weights; offset spatula; hand or stand mixer; 13-by-46 cm rimmed baking sheet

sk.v: Metlička, škrabka na cesto, valček na cesto, vrúbkovaná forma na tart 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom, sušená fazuľa, surová ryža, alebo keramické guľôčky na slepé pečenie, zalomená stierka, ručný alebo stojanový mixér, plech s okrajom 13 × 46 cm

en.v: You can prepare the pastry up to 24 hours in advance. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes, or until soft enough to roll. Once cooled, finished Bakewell tart can be wrapped in foil or stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days. To freeze Bakewell tart, wrap cooled tart in a layer of plastic wrap, followed by a layer of foil. Freeze for up to 3 months. Thaw at room temperature.

sk.v: Cesto môžeme pripraviť až 24 hodín vopred. Zabalíme ho do fólie a do použitia uchovávame v chladničke. Necháme ho postáť pri izbovej teplote 10 minút, alebo kým nezmäkne natoľko, aby sa dalo vyvaľkať. Vychladnutý hotový Bakewell koláč môžeme zabaliť do alobalu alebo uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe pri izbovej teplote až 3 dni. Na zmrazenie vychladnutý koláč zabalíme do vrstvy fólie a potom do vrstvy alobalu. Zmrazíme až na 3 mesiace. Rozmrazujeme pri izbovej teplote.

c.t: For a simpler top, skip the piped icing and dust the cooled tart with powdered sugar. To add fruit, dot the unbaked tart with 60 g well-dried fresh raspberries (about 15) before scattering the almonds.

Na jednoduchší vrch vynechajte poleve a vychladnutý koláč poprášte práškovým cukrom. Ak chcete ovocie, pred posypaním mandľami poukladajte na nepečený koláč 60 g dobre osušených čerstvých malín (asi 15).

en.t: 192 g all-purpose flour
8 g (1 tbsp) confectioners' sugar
113 g cold unsalted butter (8 tbsp), cut into 1.5 cm pieces
2 large egg yolks (36 g)
1 tbsp (15 ml) ice water, plus more as needed
135 g unsalted butter (9 1/2 tbsp), at room temperature
135 g granulated sugar
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell), at room temperature
1 tsp (5 ml) almond extract
135 g blanched almond flour
100 g seedless raspberry jam
25 g sliced blanched raw almonds
50 g confectioner's sugar
2 tsp (10 ml) water
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) almond extract

1. For the Pastry: In a large bowl, whisk flour and confectioners' sugar to combine. Add butter to flour mixture and toss to evenly coat. Using your fingertips, pinch and flatten butter, then rub it between fingertips until a sandy mixture forms, 3 to 4 minutes. (It should resemble coarse breadcrumbs with some pea-size pieces still visible but no large chunks of butter remaining.)

2. In a small bowl, whisk egg yolks and ice water. Drizzle egg and water mixture over flour mixture and use a flexible spatula or dough scraper to incorporate until large clumps form. Using your hands, gently press and squeeze to bring dough together, about 1 minute more. Do not overwork the dough; it should hold together but still feel slightly crumbly, not wet or sticky. If pastry seems too dry to roll, add ice water 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) at a time, until dough holds together. Flatten into an 18 cm disc. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold to the touch, about 30 minutes.

3. On a generously floured surface, roll dough to a thickness of 0.5 cm, approximately 25 cm wide, adding more flour to the rolling pin or surface as needed to prevent the dough from sticking. Gently transfer dough to a 23 cm fluted tart pan with a removable bottom. With lightly floured fingertips, press dough into bottom edges and fluted sides of the pan; using a pastry brush, dust off any excess flour. Do not trim.

4. Refrigerate until dough is firm to the touch, about 15 minutes. With a sharp paring knife, trim away excess dough from the edges so that the dough is level with the top of the pan. Freeze until firm to the touch, about 15 minutes.

5. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Place a crumpled sheet of parchment paper inside chilled shell and fill to the brim with dried beans, sugar, raw rice, or baking weights. Bake crust until edges are firm and very lightly golden, 15 to 20 minutes. Carefully remove parchment and baking weights, set aside, and continue baking tart until golden brown all over, 10 minutes more. Let tart shell cool in pan on wire rack until warm but no longer hot to the touch, about 10 minutes.

6. Meanwhile, prepare the filling: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment or using a large bowl and an electric hand mixer, beat butter and sugar on low speed to incorporate. Increase to medium-high speed and beat until smooth and creamy, about 3 minutes. Add eggs and almond extract and mix until fully combined, scraping halfway through, 1 to 2 minutes more. (The mixture may look curdled at this point; this is normal.) Using a flexible rubber spatula, gently fold in the almond flour until just combined. Filling will resemble a thick, slightly lumpy paste.

7. In a small bowl, whisk raspberry jam until smooth. Using a small offset spatula, spread jam from side to side over bottom of tart shell to evenly cover. Dollop almond filling over jam, then use an offset spatula to cover completely. Sprinkle with sliced almonds.

8. Set pan on a 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking tray and bake until filling is puffed, deep golden brown, and firm to the touch, about 45 minutes. (If tart begins to darken too quickly, loosely tent with foil and continue baking.) Let cool in pan on wire rack until tart is room temperature, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
9. Meanwhile, prepare the icing: In a small bowl, whisk confectioners' sugar, water, and almond extract until smooth. Drizzle icing over tart. Slice and serve.

1. Cesto: Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku s práškovým cukrom. Pridáme maslo a premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalilo. Končekmi prstov maslo štipkami sploštíme a potom ho medzi prstami rozotierame, kým nevznikne piesková zmes, 3 až 4 minúty. (Mala by pripomínať hrubú strúhanku s niekoľkými ešte viditeľnými kúskami veľkosti hrášku, ale bez veľkých kúskov masla.)

2. V malej miske vyšľaháme žĺtky s ľadovou vodou. Vaječnú zmes pokvapkáme na múčnu zmes a pružnou stierkou alebo škrabkou na cesto ju zapracujeme, kým nevzniknú veľké hrudky. Rukami cesto jemne stláčame a spojíme, ešte asi 1 minútu. Cesto neprepracujeme; má držať pokope, ale ešte byť mierne drobivé, nie mokré ani lepkavé. Ak sa zdá cesto na vaľkanie príliš suché, pridávame ľadovú vodu po 1/2 ČL (2,5 ml), kým nedrží pokope. Sploštíme ho na disk s priemerom 18 cm. Zabalíme do potravinovej fólie a necháme v chladničke, kým nie je studené na dotyk, asi 30 minút.

3. Na dobre pomúčenej doske vyvaľkáme cesto na hrúbku 0,5 cm a šírku približne 25 cm; podľa potreby podsypávame valček alebo dosku múkou, aby sa cesto nelepilo. Cesto opatrne preložíme do vrúbkovanej formy na tart s priemerom 23 cm s vyberateľným dnom. Zľahka pomúčenými končekmi prstov ho vtlačíme do spodných okrajov a vrúbkovaných stien formy; cukrárskym štetcom zmetieme prebytočnú múku. Neorezávame.

4. Necháme v chladničke, kým cesto nie je pevné na dotyk, asi 15 minút. Ostrým nožíkom odrežeme prebytočné cesto z okrajov tak, aby bolo zarovno s okrajom formy. Zamrazíme, kým nie je pevné na dotyk, asi 15 minút.

5. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Do vychladeného korpusu vložíme pokrčený papier na pečenie a naplníme ho po okraj sušenou fazuľou, cukrom, surovou ryžou alebo závažiami na pečenie. Pečieme, kým okraje nie sú pevné a veľmi jemne zlatisté, 15 až 20 minút. Opatrne odstránime papier so závažiami, odložíme ich a pečieme ďalej, kým korpus nie je celý zlatohnedý, ešte 10 minút. Korpus necháme chladnúť vo forme na mriežke, kým nie je teplý, ale už nie horúci, asi 10 minút.

6. Medzitým pripravíme plnku: V mise kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom alebo vo veľkej mise ručným mixérom zmiešame na nízkej rýchlosti maslo s cukrom. Zvýšime na stredne vysokú rýchlosť a šľaháme dohladka a do krémova, asi 3 minúty. Pridáme vajcia a mandľový extrakt a miešame, kým sa úplne nespoja, v polovici zoškrabeme steny, ešte 1 až 2 minúty. (Zmes môže vyzerať zrazená; to je normálne.) Pružnou gumovou stierkou jemne vmiešame mandľovú múku, len kým sa nespojí. Plnka bude pripomínať hustú, mierne hrudkovitú pastu.

7. V malej miske vyšľaháme malinový džem dohladka. Malou lomenou stierkou ho rozotrieme po dne korpusu od okraja k okraju, aby ho rovnomerne pokryl. Na džem rozložíme kôpky mandľovej plnky a lomenou stierkou ho úplne prekryjeme. Posypeme mandľovými lupienkami.

8. Formu položíme na plech s okrajom 33 × 46 cm a pečieme, kým sa plnka nenafúkne, nie je sýto zlatohnedá a pevná na dotyk, asi 45 minút. (Ak tart tmavne príliš rýchlo, voľne ho prikryjeme alobalom a pečieme ďalej.) Necháme chladnúť vo forme na mriežke, kým nemá izbovú teplotu, 45 minút až 1 hodinu.
9. Medzitým pripravíme polevu: V malej miske vyšľaháme dohladka práškový cukor, vodu a mandľový extrakt. Polevou pokvapkáme tart. Nakrájame a podávame.

cat.en: For a simpler top, skip the piped icing and dust the cooled tart with powdered sugar. To add fruit, dot the unbaked tart with 60 g well-dried fresh raspberries (about 15) before scattering the almonds.

tip.en: Whisk the raspberry jam in a small bowl until smooth before spreading it over the pastry.

tip.en: Raspberry jam is most traditional, but cherry preserves are a common variation; don't confuse the tart with the mass-produced 'cherry Bakewell' cake.

en.t: 227 g water, for the choux
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, cold, for the choux
3/8 tsp (2 g) table salt, for the choux
150 g all-purpose flour, for the choux
4 large eggs, for the choux
99 g granulated sugar, for the pastry cream
5 tbsp (35 g) cornstarch, for the pastry cream
4 large egg yolks, for the pastry cream
454 g milk, whole preferred, for the pastry cream
43 g unsweetened cocoa, Dutch-process or natural, for the pastry cream
57 g unsweetened baking chocolate, chopped, for the pastry cream
1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, cold, for the pastry cream
113 g semisweet chocolate, chopped, for the glaze
1 1/2 tsp (10 g) light corn syrup, for the glaze
113 g heavy cream, for the glaze
1. Preheat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Lightly grease (or line with parchment) two baking sheets.

2. Make the choux: Combine the water, butter, and salt in a medium saucepan, heat until the butter has melted, and bring to a rolling boil. Remove the pan from the heat and add the flour all at once, stirring vigorously. Return the pan to medium heat and cook, stirring all the while, until the mixture smooths out and follows the spoon around the pan, less than 1 minute.

3. Remove the pan from the heat and let the mixture cool for 5 to 10 minutes; it should be below 52 °C (it will still feel hot, but you should be able to hold a finger in it for a few seconds). Transfer to a mixer and beat in the eggs one at a time; it will look curdled at first but should become smooth when the last egg is added. Beat for at least 2 minutes after adding the last egg.
4. Pipe the batter into 13 cm logs about 2 cm in diameter, or use a spoon or cookie scoop to drop small mounds of batter in a 13 cm line, gently spreading them into one solid pastry.
5. Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C) and bake for 25 minutes more, until the pastries are a medium golden brown. Don't open the oven door while they bake.

6. Remove the pastries from the oven, make a small slit in the top of each, and return them to the oven for 5 minutes to let the steam escape. Cool on a rack. When cool enough to handle, split each in half into top and bottom pieces; exposing the centers to air helps keep them from becoming soggy.
7. Make the pastry cream: Combine the sugar and cornstarch in a mixing bowl and whisk in the yolks. Bring the milk and cocoa just to a simmer in a saucepan over medium heat.

8. Whisk a quarter of the hot milk mixture into the yolk mixture, then return everything to the saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture becomes very thick and just barely starts to boil. Remove from heat and stir in the chocolate and butter until melted and smooth.
9. Transfer the pastry cream to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for about 2 hours.

10. Make the glaze: Put the chocolate and corn syrup in a medium bowl. Heat the cream to simmering, pour it over the chocolate, and stir until melted and smooth. If the glaze seems thin, let it cool and set a bit before using.
11. Assemble: Pipe or spoon the pastry cream into the pastries, then dip the tops of each one into the glaze. For best results, serve immediately, or refrigerate and serve within several hours.

1. Rúru predhrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C). Dva plechy zľahka vymastíme (alebo vystelieme papierom na pečenie).

2. Pripravíme odpaľované cesto: v strednom hrnci spojíme vodu, maslo a soľ, zohrievame, kým sa maslo neroztopí, a privedieme do prudkého varu. Hrniec odstavíme z ohňa, naraz pridáme všetku múku a energicky miešame. Hrniec vrátime na stredný oheň a za stáleho miešania zohrievame, kým sa zmes nevyhladí a neťahá sa za varechou po hrnci, necelú 1 minútu.

3. Hrniec odstavíme z ohňa a zmes necháme 5 až 10 minút chladnúť; má mať menej ako 52 °C (stále bude pôsobiť horúco, ale prst v nej vydržíme niekoľko sekúnd). Preložíme do kuchynského robota a po jednom zašľahávame vajcia; najprv bude zmes vyzerať zrazene, ale po pridaní posledného vajca by mala byť hladká. Po pridaní posledného vajca šľaháme ešte aspoň 2 minúty.

4. Cesto nastriekame do pásikov dlhých 13 cm s priemerom asi 2 cm, alebo lyžicou či naberačkou na sušienky kladieme malé kôpky cesta do 13 cm dlhého radu a jemne ich roztrieme do jedného súvislého pásika.
5. Pečieme 15 minút, potom znížime teplotu na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C) a pečieme ešte 25 minút, kým nie sú stredne zlatohnedé. Počas pečenia neotvárame dvierka rúry.

6. Éclairs vyberieme z rúry, na vrchu každého urobíme malý zárez a vrátime ich na 5 minút do rúry, aby unikla para. Necháme vychladnúť na mriežke. Keď sa dajú chytiť, každý prekrojíme napoly na vrchnú a spodnú časť; keď je stred vystavený vzduchu, nerozmočí sa.
7. Pripravíme krém: v mise zmiešame cukor s kukuričným škrobom a metličkou vmiešame žĺtky. V hrnci na strednom ohni zohrejeme mlieko s kakaom práve k bodu varu.

8. Štvrtinu horúcej mliečnej zmesi zašľaháme do žĺtkovej zmesi, potom všetko vrátime do hrnca na stredný oheň. Za stáleho miešania varíme, kým zmes veľmi nezhustne a práve nezačne vrieť. Odstavíme z ohňa a vmiešame čokoládu a maslo, kým sa neroztopia a krém nie je hladký.
9. Krém preložíme do misy a prikryjeme fóliou. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu a potom asi 2 hodiny v chladničke.

10. Pripravíme polevu: čokoládu a kukuričný sirup dáme do strednej misy. Smotanu zohrejeme k bodu varu, nalejeme na čokoládu a miešame, kým sa čokoláda neroztopí a poleva nie je hladká. Ak sa poleva zdá riedka, necháme ju pred použitím trochu vychladnúť a zhustnúť.
11. Skladanie: krém nastriekame alebo lyžicou naplníme do éclairs, potom vrch každého namočíme do polevy. Najlepšie je podávať ich hneď, alebo ich dáme do chladničky a podáme do niekoľkých hodín.

en.t: 945 ml homemade or store-bought vanilla ice cream, softened slightly
235 ml water, for the choux
6 tbsp (84 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm cubes, for the choux
2 tsp (8 g) sugar (optional), for the choux
1/2 tsp (2 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume), for the choux
128 g all-purpose flour, sifted, for the choux
4 large eggs (200 g), for the choux
Powdered sugar, for dusting
230 g bittersweet chocolate, about 60%, chopped
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) instant espresso powder
295 ml heavy cream

1. Make the choux: In a 2800 ml stainless-steel saucier or saucepan, combine the liquid, butter, sugar (if using), and salt. Set over high heat and cook until the liquid comes to a rolling boil and the butter has fully melted, about 2 minutes.

2. Remove from heat and add the flour. Using a wooden spoon or stiff silicone spatula, mix in the flour thoroughly until no lumps remain. Return the saucepan to medium-high heat and cook, stirring very frequently, until the dough registers 80 °C on an instant-read thermometer (or until a thin starchy film forms all over the inside of the pan and the dough pulls together into a cohesive mass).

3. Transfer the dough to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle and beat at medium speed until it registers 63 °C. Add the eggs one at a time, beating each in fully before adding the next (start at medium-low speed for the first egg, then increase to medium). Scrape down the bowl, then mix at medium speed for about 5 seconds more. (Alternatively, let the dough cool in the pan to 63 °C, stirring frequently, and beat in the eggs by hand one at a time until a smooth, shiny paste forms.)
4. Transfer the choux to a pastry bag fitted with a 1.5 cm plain round tip. Use it right away, or keep the bag sealed at room temperature for up to 2 hours.

5. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and place in freezer until cold, about 10 minutes. Remove prepared baking sheet from freezer. Using a 57 g ice cream scoop, scoop 18 balls of ice cream onto prepared baking sheet and place in freezer until ice cream is firm, about 30 minutes.

6. Adjust oven racks to upper-middle and lower-middle positions and preheat oven to 204 °C (fan 184 °C). Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Pipe a small amount of choux paste under each corner of parchment paper (the dough acts as a glue and keeps the paper in place as you pipe).

7. To pipe the choux puffs, hold the filled pastry bag at a 90° angle, apply steady downward pressure, and pipe a 5 cm-wide mound. To stop piping, cease applying pressure and swirl the pastry tip away. Continue to pipe choux mounds about 7.5 cm apart, for a total of 9 choux mounds. Repeat with second tray. To smooth the surface of any uneven choux mounds, dip a finger into cold water and gently pat down any bumps. Dust choux mounds evenly with powdered sugar.

8. Bake both trays until choux mounds are puffed, deeply golden brown, and feel hollow when lifted, about 25 minutes. Turn off oven, crack the door open, and let stand for 30 minutes to allow profiteroles to dry and fully set. Remove from oven and let cool completely, about 15 minutes.

9. To Make the Chocolate Sauce: In a heatproof medium bowl that will sit comfortably on top of a 945 ml stainless steel saucepan without toppling over, combine chocolate, salt, and espresso powder. In a 945 ml stainless-steel saucepan, heat cream over medium-high heat until it has reached a simmer and started to bubble hard around the edges. Immediately pour hot cream over chocolate and let stand 1 minute. Whisk until smooth.
10. Clean saucepan and fill with 2.5 cm water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Turn off heat, then carefully set bowl with chocolate sauce on top of the saucepan to keep warm.

11. To serve, using a serrated knife, slice each choux puff in half to create a top and bottom "bun.” Place a scoop of ice cream on each bottom half. Cover with the top half of each puff. Serve profiteroles immediately with chocolate sauce drizzled on top.

1. Pripravíme odpaľované cesto: v 2,8-litrovom nerezovom rendlíku alebo hrnci spojíme tekutinu, maslo, cukor (ak ho používame) a soľ. Postavíme na silný oheň a zohrievame, kým tekutina nezačne prudko vrieť a maslo sa úplne neroztopí, asi 2 minúty.

2. Odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme múku. Drevenou varechou alebo pevnou silikónovou stierkou múku dôkladne vmiešame, kým nezostanú žiadne hrudky. Hrniec vrátime na stredne silný oheň a za veľmi častého miešania zohrievame, kým vpichový teplomer v ceste neukáže 80 °C (alebo kým sa po celej vnútornej strane hrnca nevytvorí tenký škrobový povlak a cesto sa nespojí do súdržnej hmoty).

3. Cesto preložíme do misy kuchynského robota s plochým miešadlom a na strednej rýchlosti miešame, kým teplomer neukáže 63 °C. Po jednom pridávame vajcia a každé úplne zapracujeme, kým pridáme ďalšie (pri prvom vajci začneme na stredne nízkej rýchlosti, potom zvýšime na strednú). Zotrieme steny misy a miešame na strednej rýchlosti ešte asi 5 sekúnd. (Prípadne necháme cesto vychladnúť v hrnci na 63 °C, často ho premiešame, a vajcia zapracujeme ručne po jednom, kým nevznikne hladká lesklá hmota.)
4. Odpaľované cesto preložíme do cukrárskeho vrecka s hladkou okrúhlou špičkou 1,5 cm. Použijeme ho hneď, alebo ho v uzavretom vrecku necháme pri izbovej teplote najviac 2 hodiny.

5. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie a dáme ho do mrazničky vychladiť, asi 10 minút. Pripravený plech vyberieme z mrazničky. Naberačkou na zmrzlinu s objemom 57 g naberieme na plech 18 guľôčok zmrzliny a dáme do mrazničky, kým zmrzlina nie je pevná, asi 30 minút.

6. Rošty nastavíme do hornej a dolnej tretiny rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 204 °C (teplovzdušnú na 184 °C). Dva plechy s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Pod každý roh papiera nastriekame trochu odpaľovaného cesta (cesto funguje ako lepidlo a drží papier na mieste počas striekania).

7. Naplnené cukrárske vrecko držíme pod uhlom 90°, rovnomerne tlačíme nadol a nastriekame kôpku širokú 5 cm (pozri poznámku). Keď chceme prestať, uvoľníme tlak a špičku krúživým pohybom odtiahneme. Pokračujeme v striekaní kôpok s rozostupmi asi 7,5 cm, spolu 9 kôpok. Rovnako postupujeme na druhom plechu. Nerovné kôpky zarovnáme tak, že prst namočíme do studenej vody a jemne pritlačíme hrbolčeky. Kôpky rovnomerne poprášime práškovým cukrom.

8. Oba plechy pečieme, kým sa kôpky nenafúknu, nie sú sýto zlatohnedé a pri zdvihnutí nie sú duté, asi 25 minút. Rúru vypneme, dvierka pootvoríme a necháme stáť 30 minút, aby profiteroles vyschli a úplne stuhli. Vyberieme z rúry a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 15 minút.

9. Čokoládová omáčka: V strednej žiaruvzdornej mise, ktorá bezpečne sedí na nerezovom hrnci s objemom 945 ml bez prevrhnutia, zmiešame čokoládu, soľ a espresso prášok. V nerezovom hrnci s objemom 945 ml zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni smotanu, kým nezačne mierne vrieť a silno bublať po okrajoch. Horúcu smotanu hneď nalejeme na čokoládu a necháme stáť 1 minútu. Vyšľaháme dohladka.
10. Hrniec umyjeme a nalejeme doň 2,5 cm vody. Privedieme do varu na silnom ohni. Oheň vypneme a misu s čokoládovou omáčkou opatrne položíme na hrniec, aby zostala teplá.

11. Pri podávaní každú kôpku prekrojíme zúbkovaným nožom na polovicu, aby vznikla vrchná a spodná „žemlička“. Na každú spodnú polovicu položíme guľôčku zmrzliny. Prikryjeme vrchnou polovicou. Profiteroles hneď podávame, pokvapkané čokoládovou omáčkou.

1. Make the choux: In a 2800 ml stainless-steel saucier or saucepan, combine the liquid, butter, sugar (if using), and salt. Set over high heat and cook until the liquid comes to a rolling boil and the butter has fully melted, about 2 minutes.

2. Remove from heat and add the flour. Using a wooden spoon or stiff silicone spatula, mix in the flour thoroughly until no lumps remain. Return the saucepan to medium-high heat and cook, stirring very frequently, until the dough registers 80 °C on an instant-read thermometer (or until a thin starchy film forms all over the inside of the pan and the dough pulls together into a cohesive mass).

3. Transfer the dough to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle and beat at medium speed until it registers 63 °C. Add the eggs one at a time, beating each in fully before adding the next (start at medium-low speed for the first egg, then increase to medium). Scrape down the bowl, then mix at medium speed for about 5 seconds more. (Alternatively, let the dough cool in the pan to 63 °C, stirring frequently, and beat in the eggs by hand one at a time until a smooth, shiny paste forms.)
4. Transfer the choux to a pastry bag fitted with a 2 cm star tip. Use it right away, or keep the bag sealed at room temperature for up to 2 hours.

5. Prepare the Choux: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Using a pen or pencil, trace a 20 cm circle in the center of a 30 × 41 cm sheet of parchment paper. Flip parchment over so that drawn ring is on underside and set on a large, rimmed baking sheet. Pipe a small amount of choux dough under each corner of parchment paper lining baking sheet (dough acts as a glue and keeps paper in place as you pipe).

To stop piping, cease applying pressure and swirl pastry tip away from piped ring. Pipe a second ring of choux just inside first ring, making sure that the two rings are touching one another. Pipe a third, final ring of choux on top of, and nestling in the groove between, the two piped rings. To smooth out surface of dough, dip a finger into additional cold water and gently pat down any bumps as needed.

7. In a small bowl, whisk together egg and 1 tbsp (15 ml) water until smooth. Using a pastry brush, gently brush choux rings with egg wash. Bake in preheated oven until choux is puffed and light golden brown, about 15 minutes. Without opening the oven door, reduce oven temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Bake until deep golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Turn off oven, partially open door, and let choux stand in turned-off oven for 30 minutes to allow pastry to dry and fully set. Remove from oven and let cool completely, about 15 minutes.

8. While choux is cooling in oven, prepare the Crème Mousseline: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat butter on medium speed until fluffy and light, about 5 minutes. Using a rubber spatula, scrape down bowl and beater. With mixer on medium speed, add pastry cream a few tbsp at a time, pausing to scrape down bowl and paddle as needed, until thoroughly incorporated, about 1 minute. Switch to whisk attachment and whip mixture on medium speed until Crème Mousseline is soft and airy, about 3 minutes. Transfer Crème Mousseline to a pastry bag fitted with a 2 cm star tip; refrigerate until ready to use.

9. Transfer cooled choux ring to a large cutting board. Using a serrated knife, cut choux ring in half horizontally. Carefully lift top off and place on a wire rack set inside a large, rimmed baking sheet; set aside.

10. Prepare the Chocolate Glaze: Place chocolate, butter, corn syrup, and salt in a medium-size, microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high power in 15 second increments, stirring after each increment, until chocolate is melted and mixture is completely smooth, about 1 minute total. Gently pour over top choux ring in an even layer. Allow glaze to set, at room temperature, about 45 minutes.

11. Pipe Crème Mousseline in even rosettes about 4 cm-high onto cut side of bottom half of choux ring, making sure to apply steady pressure while piping. Place glazed top half of choux ring over piped filling. Using a serrated knife, slice into portions, and serve.

3. Transfer the dough to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle and beat at medium speed until it registers 63 °C. Add the eggs one at a time, beating each in fully before adding the next (start at medium-low speed for the first egg, then increase to medium). Scrape down the bowl, then mix at medium speed for about 5 seconds more. (Alternatively, let the dough cool in the pan to 63 °C, stirring frequently, and beat in the eggs by hand one at a time until a smooth, shiny paste forms.)
4. Transfer the choux to a pastry bag fitted with a 2 cm star tip. Use it right away, or keep the bag sealed at room temperature for up to 2 hours.

5. Prepare the Choux: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Using a pen or pencil, trace a 20 cm circle in the center of a 30 × 41 cm sheet of parchment paper. Flip parchment over so that drawn ring is on underside and set on a large, rimmed baking sheet. Pipe a small amount of choux dough under each corner of parchment paper lining baking sheet (dough acts as a glue and keeps paper in place as you pipe).

To stop piping, cease applying pressure and swirl pastry tip away from piped ring. Pipe a second ring of choux just inside first ring, making sure that the two rings are touching one another. Remove from oven and let cool completely, about 15 minutes.

Using a rubber spatula, scrape down bowl and beater. Switch to whisk attachment and whip mixture on medium speed until Crème Mousseline is soft and airy, about 3 minutes. 9. Transfer cooled choux ring to a large cutting board. Using a serrated knife, cut choux ring in half horizontally. Carefully lift top off and place on a wire rack set inside a large, rimmed baking sheet; set aside.

10. Prepare the Chocolate Glaze: Place chocolate, butter, corn syrup, and salt in a medium-size, microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high power in 15 second increments, stirring after each increment, until chocolate is melted and mixture is completely smooth, about 1 minute total.
